items.problem: WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:<Type>' (+ WMC1111/WMC1509) when a DataTemplate uses x:Bind/x:DataType on a project-local type (here inside NavigationView.MenuItemTemplate).
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 79-98: MainPage.xaml WMC0909 Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario and WMC1111 'DataTemplates containing x:Bind need a DataType'; agent recovered by switching the template to {Binding Title} without x:DataType.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md id~='Resource references' failure-mode note discusses WMC9999/WMC1509 as dangling-key symptoms, but WMC0909/WMC1111 (compiled-binding DataType resolution in a template) is not addressed.
items.proposed_improvement: Add one line to the existing XAML failure-mode note: WMC0909/WMC1111 mean a DataTemplate's x:Bind/x:DataType type could not be resolved on the markup pass — for a simple item template the reliable fix is classic {Binding Prop} without x:DataType; do not chase it as a missing resource.
items.generalizes: Migrated UWP list/nav templates commonly use x:Bind with a local DataType and hit this on the first compile; a one-line disambiguation between WMC0909 (binding DataType) and WMC9999 (dangling resource key) saves repeated guessing.
